mapper.select: select com_name from company where com_id = #{comId}
mapper.insert: insert into appr_form ( com_id, for_code, for_title, for_content, for_schema, for_status, for_category ) values ( #{comId}, #{forCode}, #{forTitle}, #{forContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{forSchema, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{forStatus}, #{forCategory, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: update appr_form set com_id = #{req.comId}, for_code = #{req.forCode}, for_title = #{req.forTitle}, for_content = #{req.forContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, for_schema = #{req.forSchema, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, for_status = #{req.forStatus} where for_id = #{forId} and for_version = #{forVersion}
mapper.insert: insert into appr_form ( for_id, com_id, for_code, for_title, for_content, for_schema, for_status, created_at, for_version, for_category ) values ( #{forId}, #{req.comId}, #{req.forCode}, #{req.forTitle}, #{req.forContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{req.forSchema, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{req.forStatus}, sysdate, (select nvl(max(for_version), 0) + 1 from appr_form where for_id = #{forId}), #{req.forCategory, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: select f.for_id, f.for_version, f.com_id, c.com_name as comName, f.for_code, f.for_title, f.for_content, f.for_schema, f.for_status, f.is_deleted as deleted, f.created_at, f.updated_at, f.for_category from appr_form f left outer join company c on f.com_id = c.com_id where f.for_id = #{forId} and f.com_id = #{comId} order by for_version desc
select f.*, c.com_name as comName from appr_form f left outer join company c on f.com_id = c.com_id where f.for_id = #{forId} and f.for_version = #{forVersion}
